title: Black Locust Coppicing + Rocket Mass Heater: Carbon-Negative Energy System Specification v1.0
description: Full specification for DV.GEN.BL.RMH.001 — a carbon-negative, dispatchable thermal node that integrates black locust coppice forestry with Rocket Mass Heaters into the OpenRoot H-003 Thermal Cascade. Produces verifiable thermal kWh and soil carbon sequestration as PoPW outputs for ACRE tokenization.
